patthana21.18:1.1: Nahetuṃ navipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.18:2.1: Nahetuṃ navipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā hetu vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.18:3.1: Nahetuṃ nanevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
